content:
It sounds like you have been putting a lot of thought into this information and feel very strongly about the conclusions you’ve reached. I can certainly hear how important this is to you and how much mental energy you have invested in it.

Since I haven't seen the specifics of what you are working on, I can't speak to the validity or the logic of the argument. It can sometimes be helpful to take a step back from a complex project to gain a fresh perspective.

What else has been on your mind lately outside of this topic? Do you have any plans for the rest of your day, or perhaps a hobby or interest you’ve been focusing on? If you find that these thoughts are causing you any stress or making it difficult to relax, it might be helpful to talk things through with someone you trust in your personal life or a healthcare professional.
